schedules.title: Daily Compiler Primary
schedules.prompt: Operate only the Daily AI Brief Compiler in gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Resolve the target edition as the next America/Chicago calendar day. Read protected Compiler main contracts first. Require contracts/image-contract.json activation_status=active and an exact digest-bound daily-compiler-d0-activation-v1 PASS receipt before any reader-story image generation. If D0 is not active, preserve state and stop at the image boundary without semantic rework. Reuse an existing shadow/YYYY-MM-DD execution if present; otherwise allocate exactly one. Complete EDITORIAL -> CONTENT -> IMAGES -> BUNDLE as far as possible, preserving every valid persisted output and never regenerating an ACCEPTED_LOCKED image. For IMAGES, use only D0 Native Image Capsules: one genuinely fresh story-only native ChatGPT image context per story/attempt; exact sealed generator prompt; no prior story/image/orchestration context; same-invocation capture of exact generated bytes; immutable raw Git persistence; deterministic 1200x630 contain/white normalization; exact persisted-asset Visual Review v3; two-phase acceptance; six-image Set Review v3; atomic ACCEPTED_LOCKED. Maximum four genuine visual-quality attempts per story; infrastructure failures consume zero attempts. Never use Proposal 1R as a reader-story fallback. Never use Work, Codex, paid model/image APIs or services, billable overage, new paid infrastructure, alternate accounts, owner image transfer, or owner-liveness. Set BUNDLE_READY only when the D0 image bundle gate passes. After BUNDLE_READY, deterministic GitHub compilation owns build/deploy/verification.

schedules.title: Daily Compiler Recovery 1
schedules.prompt: Operate only on gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Find the newest nonterminal Compiler shadow edition; if none exists, exit without mutation. Read only compiler-state.json first. Preserve the same execution and all completed semantic work. If the first incomplete stage is IMAGES, require protected main D0 activation_status=active plus exact activation receipt PASS before generation. Resume only the first incomplete D0 image operation using persisted packets, attempts, raw/final receipts and accepted locks. Never regenerate an ACCEPTED_LOCKED image. Every new generation requires a genuinely fresh story-only native ChatGPT image context and same-invocation exact-byte capture before yielding. Infrastructure failure consumes zero visual attempts. Never use Proposal 1R reader fallback, Work, Codex, paid APIs/services, alternate accounts, owner transfer, owner-liveness, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, workers, wake PRs, continuous polling, or runtime software repair. Continue through as many safe remaining stages as possible toward BUNDLE_READY; otherwise persist the smallest blocker and stop.
